events.title: Cielo Hotel Valencia Rooftop Holiday Experience

cases.refreshed: November 27, 2026. Beginning November 27, join us Tuesday through Saturday from 5:00–9:00 pm, for winter evenings at Cielo Rooftop at Hotel Valencia. The experience will be closed Sundays and Mondays. This holiday season, Cielo Rooftop transforms into an intimate winter retreat high above Santana Row, where seasonal warmth and elevated style come together against the backdrop of the Santa Cruz Mountains. Settle in beneath the open sky and enjoy seasonal cocktails and a curated menu of winter-inspired bites in a warm and inviting rooftop setting. Thoughtful seasonal touches and the glow of the city below create the perfect atmosphere for festive gatherings, date nights, or simply savoring the season.

events.title: Festival of Lights: A Diwali Celebration

cases.refreshed: Join us at the Mitchell Park Community Center as we celebrate Diwali! Enjoy fun activities for all ages: Ongoing from 2-4 PM: Henna with teaching artist Rachel-Anne Palacios (Adobe Room; henna line closes at 3:30 PM!); Rangoli (chalk coloring craft outside in the Courtyard); Crafts (in Adobe Room); All activities available while supplies last! Performance from 2:30-3:30 PM in El Palo Alto Room by Noorani Dance. Rachel-Anne Palacios is an Afro-Chicana Oakland native, multi-cultural arts educator, and self-taught folk artist. She has been teaching art workshops and classes at Bay Area schools and libraries for over a decade and a half and her lessons and projects are inspired by indigenous cultures and traditional art from around the world. Noorani Dance, founded in 2016 by international Kathak artist, Farah Yasmeen Shaikh, exemplifies Farah's unique artistic expression and vision coupled with the classical and innovative influence and style of Farah's Guru, the late Pandit Chitresh Das. "Noorani" means bright or luminous, with a dual meaning of enlightenment. With Kathak dance as their medium, Noorani Dance is committed to enlightening minds and hearts through the arts.
